results.title: Najeriya: Mutane 64 sun mutu a harin ramuwa bayan kisan wani dagaci a Neja
results.content: A Najeriya, ƙalla mutane mazauna 64 ne suka rasa rayukansu a wasu hare-haren ramuwar gayya da aka kai a ƙarshen mako a ƙaramar hukumar Borgu ta Jihar Neja, biyo bayan kisan gillar da aka yi wa dagacin wani ƙauye a yankin.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Ukraine ta ɗau alhakin hare-hare kan jiragen ruwan Rasha a gabashin Libya
results.content: Shugaban Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, a yau Litinin ya ce dakarun ƙasarsa sun kai hare-hare kan wasu jiragen ruwan ƙasar Rasha guda biyu a gabar tekun ƙasar Libya, ta hanyar amfani da jiragen ruwa marasa matuƙa da aka ƙera a cikin gida.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Amnesty ta nemi a binciki Sarkin Daura kan zargin cin zarafin ƴar yawon buɗe ido
results.content: Ƙungiyar kare hakkin ɗan adam ta Amnesty International ta buƙaci Gwamnan Jihar Katsina, Dikko Radda, da Rundunar Ƴansandan Najeriya su gaggauta gudanar da bincike mai zaman kansa kan zargin cin zarafin wata ƴar yawon buɗe ido ta hanyar lalata da ake yi wa Sarkin Daura, Alhaji Faruk Umar Faruk.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: CAF ta amince da samar da gasar ƙwallon mata ƴan ƙasa da shekaru 17
results.content: Ƙwamitin zartaswar hukumar ƙwallon ƙafar Afirka CAF ya amince da ƙirƙirar gasar nahiyar ta mata ƴan ƙasa da shekaru U17 a wani zaman da ya yi ranar juma’ar da ta gabata a Abuja babban birnin Tarayya Najeriya.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Nadal ya zama memba a ƙwamitin zartaswar ƙungiyar Real Madrid
results.content: Tsohon zakaran wasan Tennis, Rafael Nadal ,ya zama mamba a ƙwamitin gudanarwa ƙungiyar ƙwallon kafar Real Madrid ta Spain da ya kasance magoyin baya tun a yarinta sa.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Benin za ta ƙwaso dubban ƴan ƙasarta da Guinea ta kora
results.content: Gwamnatin Jamhuriyar Benin ta fara shirin kwaso ƴan ƙasarta da suka maƙalle a hanya bayan da mahukuntan Guinea suka taso ƙeyarsu sakamakon matakan kawo ƙarshen haƙar zinare ba bisa ƙa’ida ba.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Nijar za ta fara siyo mai daga waje don magance ƙarancinsa a cikin gida
results.content: Bayanai na nuni da cewa yawan man fetur da jamhuriyar Nijar ke sayowa daga ƙetare don magance matsalar ƙarancinsa da ake fama da ita a cikin gida ya ninka fiye fa yadda ake zato. Mafi yawan ƴan ƙasar na ci gaba da ɗiga ayar tambayar domin sanin dalilan da ke haddasa wannan matsala ta ƙarancin mai da ake fama da ita fiye da watanni uku, duk da cewa ana haƙowa tare da tace wannan makamashi a cikin gida yau shekaru 14 kenan.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Gwamnatin gabashin Libya ta ce an sake kai wa wani jirgin Rasha hari Bengazi
results.content: Wata fashewa ta auku da sanyin safiyar Lahadin nan a cikin wani ƙaramin jirgin yaƙin ruwa na Rasha mai suna Merkury da ke tsaye a sansanin sojojin ruwa na Benghazi a gabashin Libya, lamarin da hukumomin yankin ke zargin harin jirgi marar matuƙi ne ya haddasa shi.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Mutane 14 sun maƙale a ɓaraguzan wani bene a Ukraine bayan harin Rasha
results.content: Shugaban Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, ya ce aƙalla mutane 14 ne ake fargabar sun maƙale a ƙarƙashin ɓaraguzan wani bene mai hawa 5 bayan wani harin jirgin sama marar matuƙi na Rasha a yankin Kyiv.

results.title: Isra'ila: Eisenkot ya gayyaci jam’iyyar Netanyahu don tattauna kafa gwamnati
results.content: Tsohon babban hafsan sojin Isra’ila, Gadi Eisenkot, wanda Shugaba Isaac Herzog ya ɗora wa alhakin kafa sabuwar gwamnatin ƙasar a ranar 8 ga Nuwamba, ya gayyaci jam’iyyar Likud ta Firaiministan riƙon ƙwarya Benjamin Netanyahu domin gudanar da sabuwar tattaunawar kafa gwamnatin haɗin kan ƙasa.

results.title: Indonesia: Mutane 3 sun mutu, 36 sun ɓace bayan gobarar masana’anta
results.content: Aƙalla mutane 3 sun rasa rayukansu yayin da wasu 36 suka ɓace bayan wata mummunar gobara ta tashi a wata masana’antar yin alawa ta PT Fonusa Agung Mulia a yankin Cikande da ke lardin Banten, yammacin tsibirin Java na ƙasar Indonesia.

results.title: Umar Saleh Anka kan gaza cimma matsaya a taron yanayi na COP31
results.content: An gaza cimma matsaya a taron Sauyin Yanayi na COP31 da aka ƙarƙare ranar Lahadi a Turkiya, bayan da ƙasashe da dama, ciki har da na Ƙungiyar Tarayyar EU, suka yi watsi da ƙudurin da aka gabatar, saboda ƙin jaddada illolin nau’ikan makamashi masu gurɓata yanayi na fetur da gas da kuma Kwal. Kan wannan Nura Ado Suleiman ya tattauna da Dakta Umar Saleh Anka, babban Daraktan kula da Sauyin Yanayi na ma’aikatar Muhalli ta jihar Kano, wanda ya halarci taron na COP31.

results.title: Kashi 70 cikin 100 na al'ummar Ghana sun rungumi tsarin inshorar lafiya
results.content: A wannan makon shirin zai mayar da hankali ne kan wani gagarumin cigaban lafiya da aka samu can a ƙasar Ghana bayan fitar wasu alƙaluma da ke nuna cewa kimanin kashi 70 cikin 100 na yawan jama’ar sun rungumi tsarin inshorar lafiyar gwamnati wanda ke matsayin hoɓɓasa a ƙoƙarin baiwa lafiyar jama’a kariya.

results.title: Rawar da tawagogin Najeriya suka taka a wasannin neman shiga AFCON da Olympic
results.content: Shirin a wannan makon zayyi duba ne kan wasanni sharen fagen zuwa gasar lashe kofin nahiyar Afrka ta AFCON da tawagar Super Eagles ta Najeriya ta yi tsakaninta da Tanzania, bayaga wanda itama tawagar ƴan ƙasa da shekaru 23 da aka fi sani da Olympics Eagles ta yi da takwararta ta DRC.

results.title: Mutane da dama ne suka mutu a wani hatsarin jirgin ruwa a Bayelsa
results.content: Hukumar Ba da agajin gaggawa ta ƙasa (NEMA) a jiya ta gano karin mutanen da suka mutu sakamakon kifewar wani kwale-kwale a mahaɗar koguna tsakanin Oweikorogha da Otuan," a gundumar Ijaw na Jihar Bayelsa a Najeriya.

results.title: Mayakan JNIM sun kashe dakarun Mali a wani hari da suka kai yankin Nioni
results.content: A ƙasar Mali,wani harin mayakan JNIM ya yi sanadiyar mutuwar dakarun ƙasar.An bayana cewa dakarun na Mali duk da goyon bayan jiragen yaƙi da suka samu sun fuskanci turjiya daga mayakan jihadi na JNIM a garin Niono da ke tsakiyar ƙasar.

results.title: Ƙasashen Turai sun yi fatali da daftarin yarjejeniyar taron sauyin yanayi
results.content: Ƙasashen Tarayyar Turai sun nuna ƙin amincewarsu ga amincewa da daftarin yarjejeniyar taron sauyin yanayi na COP31 da ake gudanarwa a birnin Antalya na ƙasar Turkiyya, saboda rashin sanya batun daina amfani da albarkatun man fetur da kwal masu gurɓata muhalli a cikinta.
